_comment: Security and cache headers for the docs site. Committed SOURCE, merged into
site/serve.json by scripts/gen-serve-config.py. The routing half of that file
is generated from mkdocs.yml; this half is hand-owned and reviewed.
Follows the house pattern set by spatialobservability.org/dist/serve.json, but
NOT its values. That site is entirely self-contained, so it can run
default-src 'self'. This one is not: the built HTML pulls from
static.zdassets.com, and mkdocs-material emits inline <script> blocks. Copying
the strict policy across would silently kill the fonts, the analytics and the
CSP therefore ships as Report-Only FIRST. A wrong CSP breaks a page for real
users and does it quietly, so it gets observed before it gets enforced. Once
the reports are clean, rename the key to Content-Security-Policy.
COOP is deliberately absent: it breaks OAuth popup flows and the site links to

headers.value: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://www.googletagmanager.com https://static.zdassets.com; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://fonts.googleapis.com; font-src 'self' data: https://fonts.gstatic.com; img-src 'self' data: https:; connect-src 'self' https://www.googletagmanager.com https://static.zdassets.com https://ekr.zdassets.com; frame-src 'self' https://static.zdassets.com; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'; form-action 'self'
accelerometer=(), camera=(), geolocation=(), gyroscope=(), magnetometer=(), microphone=(), payment=(), usb=()
